column2: WARNING Station DC Fuse Replacement Sign – Battery Feed Can Stay Live – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Battery Feed Can Stay Live. This WARNING Station DC Fuse Replacement sign from CGAP Safety reads: STATION DC FUSE REPLACEMENT / BATTERY FEED CAN REMAIN LIVE / ISOLATE ALL DC SOURCES / VERIFY BEFORE FUSE REMOVAL. Written for electric utilities, transmission substations, power plants.

Why this sign matters

A battery bank can keep a fuse circuit energized after the AC supply is shut down, so pulling a fuse can expose the tech to DC shock or an arc.

Where to post it

On the DC fuse panel door in the substation control house, beside the fuses being replaced.

Who orders it

Substation maintenance supervisors, relay techs.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.333; NFPA 70E. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.

A heavy door motor can drop when its bracket bolts are removed, and an energized door can also move.

Mount on the door header or motor housing beside the bracket bolts.

Door and lock technicians.

Mount on the generator control panel or heater junction box.

Generator technicians.
